business_summary.text: Tempsens Instruments manufactures temperature sensors, specialized cables, and electrical heating solutions for industrial applications, with 45% revenue from temperature sensing, 35% from specialized cables, and 21% from electrical heating. The company operates globally with 15 manufacturing plants and focuses on engineered, make-to-order products for critical industries.
